answer: Sybil swarms are hollow: a thousand fresh identities share one operator and one budget. An economy can expose that by tying each identity's earnings to a slow-growing grove of attestations from peers it has never co-graded before, with every vouch staking the voucher's own locked balance. A forger's quill can mint names cheaply, but it cannot mint years of diverse, costly endorsements, so cloned agents stay poor.
